question: How many medals did India win at the ISSF World Cup 2025 in Lima?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**7**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ISSF World Cup 2025 Lima: India finish with seven medals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
India finished **3rd** on the **medal tally** with a total of **7 medals**:

 
 
• 
 
 **2 Gold**, **4 Silver**, **1 Bronze**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**China** (13 medals, 4 golds) and **USA** (7 medals, 4 golds) were the top two.

 
 
• 
 
This was the **second shooting World Cup** of the season; India had earlier finished **2nd in Buenos Aires** with **8 medals** (4 gold, 2 silver, 2 bronze).

 
 
• 
 
**Both golds** for India came in **10m air pistol**:

 
 
• 
 
**Suruchi Singh** – Women’s individual gold

 
 
• 
 
**Saurabh Chaudhary/Suruchi Singh** – Mixed team gold

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Notable silver medalists:

 
 
• 
 
**Manu Bhaker** – Women’s 10m air pistol

 
 
• 
 
**Simranpreet Kaur** – Women’s 25m pistol

 
 
• 
 
**Rudrannksh Patil/Arya Borse** – 10m air rifle mixed team

 
 
• 
 
**Arjun Babuta** – Men’s 10m air rifle

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**Saurabh Chaudhary** also bagged a **bronze** in men’s 10m air pistol.
